prompt: Of the 'Big Four' of Thrash Metal, whose debut full-length was released first?
answer: Metallica. Their debut full-length album, *Kill ’Em All*, was released on July 25, 1983—before Slayer’s *Show No Mercy* (December 1983), Anthrax’s *Fistful of Metal* (1984), and Megadeth’s *Killing Is My Business… and Business Is Good!* (1985).
